messages:
Lena (PM): quick sync: decision needed on timebound promotional discounts vs permanent SKU price tiers for onboarding mid-market customers
Arun (Sales): field: customers want a 3-month promo price to land deals. procurement likes fixed monthly lines not token surprises
Zoe (Eng): implementation: promo = billing flag that maps to pricebook. low infra risk. need to ensure telemetry keeps promo vs list usage separate for lift analysis
Miles (Finance): risk: promos complicate ARR and renewal math. propose timebound discounts that expire automatically and a renewal uplift rule 
Derek (Legal): contracts: must surface promo expiry and post-promo price in the quote. add a notice period to avoid surprise billing.
pricing-bot: draft pricebook snapshot uploaded: /pricing/drafts/timebound-promos-2026-03-23.json
Lena (PM): proposal: allow 1 standard promo type "trial-discount-3mo" for mid-market: map to existing SKUs but with 30% off for 90 days. GA gating: quotes show post-promo price, billing test, telemetry tagged, legal template updated
Arun (Sales): also request a capped promo where token usage beyond X/day billed at normal rates during promo. helps prevent abuse.
Zoe (Eng): we can enforce cap via quota rule easily. default: promo_cap = None, optional per-deal cap supported. estimate: 1 sprint for promo flag, +1 sprint for cap wiring
Miles (Finance): will model the ARR impact of 30% 3mo promo vs 20% 6mo promo and post numbers by EOD
Derek (Legal): will add promo expiry clause + explicit renewal pricing disclosure. will post draft in #legal-drafts
Lena (PM): decision: approve 3-month 30% timebound promo pilot for mid-market with optional per-deal caps. GA only after two pilots, billing accuracy >99%, and renewal disclosure in quotes. action items assigned. Thanks.
